Metadata.title: Architektów 3d
Metadata.description: Public profiles for architecture studios and 3D artists.

accountVerification.subject: Confirm your e-mail address
accountVerification.body:
Hello!

To activate your account, click the link below:
{verifyUrl}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

If this was not you, ignore this message and the account will stay inactive.

accountReverification.subject: Your new verification link
accountReverification.body:
Hello!

We received a request to resend your verification link:
{verifyUrl}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

If this was not you, ignore this message.

passwordReset.subject: Password reset
passwordReset.body:
Hello!

We received a request to reset your password. Set a new one here:
{resetUrl}

The link works once and is valid for 60 minutes.

If this was not you, ignore this message and your password will stay unchanged.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password has been changed
passwordChanged.body:
Hello!

The password for your account has just been changed.

If this was not you, use the password reset option immediately and secure your e-mail inbox.

twoFactorCode.subject: Your login code
twoFactorCode.body:
Hello!

Your one-time login code:
{code}

The code is valid for a few minutes. If this was not you trying to log in, ignore this message and consider changing your password.

emailChangeConfirmation.subject: Confirm your e-mail address change

emailChangeVerification.subject: Confirm your new e-mail address
emailChangeVerification.body:
Hello!

To finish the change and set this as your account's address, click:
{verifyUrl}

If this was not you, ignore this message and your account address will stay unchanged.

handleChanged.subject: Your profile address has changed
handleChanged.body:
Hello!

Your profile address has been changed from {oldHandle} to {newHandle}.

Your new profile address:
{profileUrl}

The old address redirects to the new one until someone else claims {oldHandle}.

Works.heading: Works
Works.limitReached: The limit is {max} works. Remove one to add another.

photos.label: Photos
photos.rule: 1 to 3, JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB each; pick several at once
photos.hint: The main photo opens the work's card and is the largest on it. The first one added is main until you pick another.
photos.full: All {max} in place. To add another, remove one or replace it.
